name: Pistachio-Crusted Salmon with Orange, Radish, Onion & Mint Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 bunch radish
2 oranges
½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Mince pistachios. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and salt; stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup pistachios, unsalted
extra virgin olive oil
salt

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g salmon fillet
salt
black pepper
1 ½ tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until salmon is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl. Cut the remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add additional oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl.
Cut off skin and white pith from oranges; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
Divide salmon and salad between plates; serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
